issues.description: setuptools<82 pin leaks into runtime install_requires, not just CI
issues.detail: Adding setuptools<82 to core/setup.py extras forces this cap on every downstream user, not just the CI environment where mmcv's pkg_resources usage is the actual problem. The invariant being protected (mmcv 2.1.0 build needs pkg_resources) holds only at build time. The fix belongs in the CI scripts (which already pin it) or in a build-system requirement, not in runtime extras_require.

issues.description: Version drift between mmdet 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 and mmengine pin lacks stated rationale
issues.detail: The PR silently bumps mmdet from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 and switches mmengine from a specific git SHA (chosen for a torch 2.5 fix) to PyPI 0.10.7. No comment establishes that 0.10.7 contains the torch 2.5 fix that the prior SHA was carrying. A reader cannot verify the invariant 'mmengine supports torch 2.5' without external archaeology.

issues.description: Redundant setuptools<82 install inside setup_mmcv duplicates build_pkg pin
issues.detail: build_pkg already pins setuptools<82, and setup_mmcv now does it again. If both run in the same env this is harmless but noisy; if setup_mmcv runs standalone the pin is necessary. A one-line comment stating which invocation path requires the local pin would let a future reader prune one of them safely.

issues.description: --no-build-isolation changes the build contract without explanation
issues.detail: Switching mmcv install to --no-build-isolation means the surrounding env's setuptools/torch are used to build mmcv, which is exactly why the setuptools<82 pin matters here. The FIXME comment names the symptom but not this coupling. A reader auditing the script later will not see why removing the pin and removing --no-build-isolation must be done together.

Two FIXMEs reference mmcv issue 3325 but neither enumerates what to undo: restore mim install, drop setuptools cap in build_pkg, drop cap in core/setup.py extras, drop --no-build-isolation, and re-pin mmengine to the SHA or a newer release. A short checklist in one of the two comments would make the eventual cleanup a mechanical edit rather than a forensic exercise.

review.summary: This is a CI unblock patch responding to setuptools 82 removing pkg_resources, which breaks mmcv 2.1.0's build. The shell-script changes are reasonable as a temporary pin, though the FIXMEs would benefit from an explicit revert checklist and a note on why --no-build-isolation is coupled to the setuptools cap. The more substantive concern is leaking setuptools<82 into core/setup.py extras_require, which propagates a CI-only build constraint to every downstream installation. Decision label: UNDER-AUDITED — the fix likely works, but the invariant 'this cap is only needed at mmcv build time' is not preserved by the placement chosen in core/setup.py. NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT applies to the mmdet/mmengine version drift, which should state which release carries the torch 2.5 fix that motivated the original SHA pin.
